shots.detail_en: Rainy-night rooftop edge, the father's fall site rendered as pure imagery, no fall shown; young man in soaked white shirt clutches the old notebook at the railing, city neon smeared through the rain curtain
Round-faced man in loud floral shirt and young woman in 90s blazer burst up the rooftop stairwell into the rain, water splashing off their shoes
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: Young man turns his head, rain dripping off his jawline, the fire in his eyes pressed down to ash
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: Close on his hand crushing the notebook, knuckles white, notebook corner trembling in the rain
shots.sub: 我现在就下楼——把那间机房，烧个干净。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: Young woman steps forward through the rain curtain, eyes locked on him
shots.sub: 样本不是证供——救不了活人。
shots.speaker: 红利

shots.detail_en: The round-faced man opens his palm: a blown-up settlement slip wrinkled by tears and rain, close-up of the crumpled paper
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: Young man looks at the wrinkled slip, then up at the round face holding it
Young woman stands her ground, ledger pages clutched to her chest
shots.sub: 烧了机房，账就真的没了。
shots.speaker: 红利

shots.detail_en: Young man lowers his head and slowly opens his own rain-damp palm
Extreme close-up: he stares into his open palm, voice almost inaudible, rain beading on his knuckles
shots.sub: 我最怕的不是打不过他——是打赢的方式，跟他一模一样。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: Flashback, same rooftop on a rainy 1993 night: the father's suited back in the rain, a small boy watching from ten years away, no fall shown
Young man shuts his eyes; rain on his lashes, something else too, refusing to fall
He steps half a step back from the rooftop edge and turns around, contained, no shouting
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: Wide: three figures shoulder to shoulder in silhouette, rain washing them into one dark shape against city neon
Empty cha chaan teng at night, warm tungsten lamp; corner table with one old soda bottle standing and a bare empty spot beside it
The round-faced man sets a newly bought soda bottle gently into the empty spot and squares it up
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: Soda poured into three glass cups, bubbles surging, warm lamp behind
Three glass cups touch lightly under the lamp; the three of them around the table, nobody speaking
Young man sets his cup down, the fire back in place in his eyes
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: Young woman nods once, ledger pages clamped tighter under her arm
shots.speaker: 红利

shots.detail_en: Three of them rise and walk to the back room; warm lamp stretches their shadows long across the door panels, a line of light leaking through the door gap
shots.sub: 打熊家？这回——满仓跟定了。
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: Black screen, white Chinese end card, subtle film grain
